description: Kohinoor Spinning Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 23 July 1970 and is engaged in the business of textile spinning. It describes itself as a yarn manufacturing company supplying premium quality yarn, with mills at Aminabad and Yousaf Nagar on Bhoun Road near Chakwal and its head office in Gulberg III, Lahore.
headOffice: 7/1-E-3, Main Boulevard, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: the company's own website at https://www.kohinoorspinningmills.com (home page vision/mission and business activities, governance page for the CEO, contact addresses and telephones) and the PSX company profile for KOSM at https://dps.psx.com.pk/company/KOSM (incorporation date) (accessed 2026-10-17)
